semiconductor_relevance: High - PROTEC Co., Ltd. specializes in automation equipment for the semiconductor packaging industry, particularly in high-precision dispensing and die bonding technologies.
summary: PROTEC Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of automation equipment focused on the semiconductor, LED, and SMT/PCBA packaging sectors. The company is recognized for its innovative high-precision dispensing technology and advanced LED die bonding solutions, aimed at enhancing performance and meeting customer demands.
